name: Wojo Live Rosin | Lemon Stank
description:
Lineage : Garlic Grove x Grape Gasoline

Effects : Awaken and Smile

Flavor Profile : Citrus

Bred By : COMPOUND GENETICS

Gasoline/Lemon lovers rejoice – this plant is for you.

The nose brings you a pure lemon scent that slowly travels to the back of your throat once smoked, providing a clean, fresh finish.

The terpene profile is reminiscent of lemon Pledge and delivers an upbeat cerebral high.
